article.title: Orange逐步部署帳單客服代理，按代理設定回答及成本上限
article.title_en: Orange phases in billing support agents with per-agent scope and cost limits
article.summary: Algolia稱Orange已在部分市場使用Agent Studio，處理帳單及帳戶支援。
article.summary_en: Algolia says Orange has started using Agent Studio for billing and account support in some markets.
highlights: 每個代理可分別設定可回答的範圍與運作成本上限。
代理使用Orange自身的產品、規則和知識資料。
highlights_en: Each agent can have its own conversation boundaries and operating cost ceiling.
Agents use Orange’s product data, rules and knowledge content.
article.why: 客服團隊可按查詢類型設定邊界，逐步處理顧客購買後的問題。
article.why_en: Support teams can define boundaries by query type as they expand post-purchase automation.
article.next_step: 先選一類低風險帳單查詢，列明可引用資料、轉人工條件及每宗成本。
article.next_step_en: Start with one low-risk query type and document permitted sources, human escalation and cost per case.
article.detail: Orange本來已有使用Algolia的搜尋服務。公告這次交代的是把代理逐步放入帳單及帳戶查詢，並分開設定每個代理可處理的問題和開支。供應商稱已有部分市場啟用，後續擴展視結果而定。團隊評估這種做法時，可分開監察答案是否有資料支持、何時需要轉人工，以及每宗個案的處理成本。
article.detail_en: Orange already used Algolia search. The new work brings agents into billing and account queries with individual scope and spend controls. Algolia reports some markets live and further expansion dependent on results. Track grounded answers, escalations and case costs separately.
